notes: v1.31.0: Motion-parity creative analytics — Merlin now does what a tool like Motion does (AI creative tagging, video hook/hold metrics, a creative leaderboard, and competitor-ad breakdowns) on its OWN closed taxonomy, fed back into generation. Anchor: 2026-06-27. (1) 8-DIMENSION LIVE-AD TAGGING (shipped v1.31.0 binary): the wisdom-categorize tagger now classifies each of a brand's live ads across angle, hook, asset_type, visual_format, offer, seasonality, cta AND matches it to one of the brand's manifest personas — all from creative copy Merlin already pulls (no new platform reporting). Every dimension is clamped to a closed vocabulary (the same tamper-proof boundary as angle/hook), persona to the brand's actual roster; a taxonomy-version marker backfills the new dims onto older angle/hook-only rows without overriding a known name-encoded angle. (2) VIDEO-CREATIVE METRICS (meta.go): the Meta insights pull now requests video_thruplay_watched_actions (3-sec video_view arrives in actions) and computes HOOK RATE (3s plays / impressions), HOLD RATE (ThruPlays / 3s plays), and THUMBSTOP RATIO per video ad — the signature Motion metrics that were documented but never computed. They persist to ads-live.json (zero-skipped for static ads) and roll up per category bucket in BrandWisdom, so a brand sees 'your UGC ads hold at 52%'. (3) CREATIVE LEADERBOARD (renderer.js + style.css): the Wisdom overlay now leads with 'Your Winning Patterns' — the brand's OWN live-ad leaderboard ranked by ROAS across all 8 tagged dimensions with the video hook/hold rates per bucket — above the collective 'What's Working Across Merlin'. Renders only when the brand has tagged live ads (additive; the collective view is unchanged otherwise). (4) COMPETITOR BREAKDOWN (new competitor-breakdown action): reads the top-performing ads in the brand's niche via TrendTrack, classifies each ad's copy into Merlin's closed taxonomy (persona-less; competitor ads don't map to YOUR personas), and returns the most common competitor hooks, angles, offers, CTAs, and formats — 'what's working in my category right now' aggregated, not just a scroll of individual ads. Bounded to 15 LLM classifications/call, TrendTrack-credit + Gemini gated, friendly errors (Rule 6). Surfaced via the dashboard MCP tool (competitor-breakdown action, 180s timeout). MERLIN'S EDGE over Motion: the taxonomy is Merlin's own and already feeds the creative matrix sampler + brand-guide synthesizer — a closed generate→measure→generate loop Motion can't do. SCOPE: the new tagging dimensions + video metrics stay LOCAL (brand-private) in this release; cross-brand collective propagation is a deliberate follow-up that touches the signed report + wisdom-api validation. Tests: +4 Go (video parse hook/hold/thumbstop, static-ad zero, field-list source-scan, per-bucket hook/hold aggregation) + competitor breakdown (ranking/cap/empty/persona-less source-scan + routing) + 3 renderer/MCP guards (brand leaderboard surfaces all 8 dims + video rates, section-divider CSS, competitor-breakdown MCP enum + long timeout). Full Go suite green; renderer 147/147; full app JS suite green. NO BREAKING CHANGES — all additive; legacy/untagged ads contribute nothing (empty values never bucketed), brands with no persona roster skip persona, static ads have no video metrics. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.30.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.30.0: Truesight week-over-week growth — show clients how their funnel is GROWING, not just where it stands. Anchor: 2026-06-26. THE STORY: a CMO doesn't just want today's numbers, they want to show a client 'THIS is how your brand is growing' — and growth shows up at the TOP of the funnel first. Reach and mindshare climb BEFORE revenue does (mindshare precedes revenue), so Truesight now leads with that. ENGINE (truesight.go): runTruesight was refactored into a reusable truesightWindow(days) helper and now resolves TWO windows — the current window AND a double-length window — concurrently. Because every funnel metric (ad impressions, GA4 sessions, add-to-cart, orders, revenue) is an additive sum, the prior period is derived exactly as prior = both - current per stage; no second date-ranged API surface was needed. Each FunnelStage gains Prior + DeltaPct + HasPrior; the payload gains WoWDays. The comparison ALWAYS follows the window the revenue bar has active — 7-day shows vs the prior 7 days, 30-day vs the prior 30 days, 90-day vs the prior 90 days — and the header label adapts to match ('Week over week' / 'vs the previous month' / 'vs the previous 3 months' / 'vs yesterday'). WoW is computed only when 2*days stays within the 365-day cap (always true for the default 7-day funnel; very long windows opt out rather than compare against a clamped, lying prior window). A negative prior (float / eventual-consistency noise) clamps to 0; a zero prior with positive current reads as 'new' rather than an infinite percentage; availability is gated on BOTH windows so a delta is never invented from a stage only one window can see. UI (renderer.js + style.css): the funnel now opens with a GROWTH HEADER that leads with the two leading indicators — Reach (awareness) and Mindshare (visits) — plus Intent (add-to-cart) and Revenue (bought) tiles, each showing its week-over-week delta, under the framing line 'Mindshare precedes revenue — watch reach and site visits climb before sales follow.' The header only appears when at least one leading indicator has a prior window. Every funnel bar also carries its own WoW chip next to the big number: green up-triangle for growth, red down-triangle for decline, a cyan 'new' chip for a stage that had zero last period, and a quiet 'no change' chip for flat. All chips render through the existing escaped sinks (delta is a number, labels are escapeHtml'd). COPY: the revenue hero label changed from 'revenue from Merlin's ads' to 'revenue generated with Merlin' — Merlin drives more than just ad spend, and the broader phrasing is the accurate claim (the 'revenue tracked' fallback label is unchanged). Tests: +4 Go engine tests (prior=both-current subtraction with up/down/new/flat cases, availability gating across both windows, negative-prior clamp, round-1 helper) + 5 renderer/style source-scan guards (delta-badge branches, growth-header leads-with-reach/mindshare + 'mindshare precedes revenue' framing, funnel prepends header + badges each stage, growth/delta CSS, the revenue-label copy with a no-stale-copy guard). Full Go suite green; full app JS suite green. NO BREAKING CHANGES — WoW is additive and read-only; Truesight still degrades to connect-CTAs when sources aren't connected, and a brand with no prior-period data simply shows the funnel without growth chips (HasPrior false everywhere). The extra double-length pull doubles Truesight's read volume per open, fully PreflightCheck-gated like every other pull (Rule 4); Truesight stays read-only, strategy-3 non-dedup (fresh per-window recompute). Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.29.1. PRIOR RELEASE v1.29.1: Truesight + Palantir polish (post-1.29.0 feedback). Anchor: 2026-06-22. TRUESIGHT now (1) CACHES per brand+window and PREFETCHES on launch / brand switch / window change, so the funnel opens INSTANTLY every time — stale-while-revalidate: it shows the cached funnel immediately, refreshes in the background, and NEVER downgrades good cached data to an error message on a transient refresh failure. (2) FOLLOWS THE REVENUE (perf) BAR WINDOW: the redundant in-panel 7/30/90 toggle + refresh button were removed; Truesight reads whatever window the revenue bar has active (1D/7D/1M/3M/12M) and re-syncs when it changes. (3) Uses FIXED funnel-bar widths (a clean, always-legible narrowing shape) instead of the data-proportional power-scale, so the funnel reads at a glance regardless of the impressions:orders ratio. (4) Is HONEST ABOUT THIN DATA: when Google Analytics is not connected, the visit / add-to-cart stages fall back to AD-ATTRIBUTED pixel events only (a sliver of true site-wide totals), so those stages are now labeled 'ad-attributed' with a one-click 'Connect Google Analytics' nudge for site-wide numbers — this is why a high-traffic store can show a low add-to-cart count (the number is ad-clicked carts, not all carts; connecting GA4 fixes it). PALANTIR: the loading / empty / error portal now spans the full idea-wall grid so it is CENTERED from first paint — fixes the off-center-then-jump layout shift when the wall loads. AGENCY REPORTS (critical): report generation was completely broken — the renderer opened the report via window.open, but the app denies every renderer-initiated window open by design (setWindowOpenHandler returns deny), so it failed 100% of the time behind a misleading 'popup blocker' message. Reports now open by handing the HTML to the main process, which writes it to a temp file and opens it in the OS default browser via shell.openPath — nothing a popup blocker can intercept; the report HTML stays our own (no inline handlers, brand data escaped) and is never executed in-app. META OAUTH SCOPE FIX: v1.29.0 added catalog_management to the binary's Meta login scopes but not to the Node fast-open browser flow, so the real consent screen requested 5 scopes while the binary expected 6 — catalog_management was never actually consented, undermining the Meta App Review resubmission. oauth-provider-config.js now matches the binary (6 scopes); the cross-repo parity guard in oauth-provider-config.test.js confirms it (26/0). Tests: +11 renderer/style/main source-scan guards (cache + stale-while-revalidate + no-downgrade, prefetch on 3 paths, follows-perf-bar, fixed bars, ad-attributed nudge, Palantir CLS span, report-opens-via-main-not-window.open, report temp-file+shell.openPath); full app JS suite green (1310 pass / 0 fail). NO BREAKING CHANGES — additive UI polish; Truesight stays read-only and degrades to connect-CTAs. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.29.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.29.0: Truesight — see your entire marketing funnel at a glance. Anchor: 2026-06-22. NEW FULL-WINDOW VIEW: a 'Truesight' button (one slot RIGHT of Palantir) opens a full-window funnel takeover that, with ZERO configuration, aggregates every connected data source into the four stages a CMO actually steers on — Saw your ads (ad impressions across Meta/TikTok/Google/Amazon) -> Visited your site (Google Analytics sessions) -> Added to cart -> Bought — for the current window (7/30/90-day toggle, defaults to 7). HONEST BY DESIGN (military-grade): instead of naively summing one metric across sources (which double-counts people and lies), each stage resolves to its MOST AUTHORITATIVE source with visible provenance — GA4 owns the on-site funnel (sessions -> add-to-cart -> purchase are one comparable population, so those rates are exact), ad impressions sum across platforms (valid — distinct deliveries), Shopify/Stripe own conversions, ad pixels are the clearly-labeled fallback. A stage with no connected source shows a one-click 'Connect' CTA, never a fabricated zero; stage-to-stage rates are flagged 'directional' when the two stages come from different measurement systems. NEW Go: truesight.go aggregator + the truesight action; reuses existing PreflightCheck-gated pulls (no new HTTP client — Rule 4), read-only, friendly errors (Rule 6), strategy-3 non-dedup (fresh per-window recompute). Also available in chat via mcp__merlin__dashboard action 'truesight'. META APP REVIEW: catalog_management added to the Facebook login scope so reviewers are prompted for (and can observe) the product-catalog / DPA features — the gap behind the May-27 rejection (ads_read intentionally dropped as redundant with ads_management). Tests: truesight_test.go (9 — stage authority order, no-fake-zero CTAs, soft cross-source step detection, same-provider hard rates) + 8 renderer source-scan guards + the Meta scope-frozen test. Independently audited + adversarially tested to 10/10; full Go suite green; full app JS suite green. NO BREAKING CHANGES — Truesight is additive + read-only and degrades gracefully to connect-CTAs when sources aren't connected. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.28.1. PRIOR RELEASE v1.28.1: Connect Microsoft Clarity + PostHog from the Connections panel, a brand-switcher click fix, and an app-wide reliability/speed/UX hardening pass. Anchor: 2026-06-22. CONNECTION TILES: Microsoft Clarity (free behavioral analytics: heatmaps, session recordings, rage/dead clicks, scroll depth) and PostHog (product analytics: funnels, retention, events) now have Connections tiles. Both connectors shipped backend-only in v1.25.0; this adds the masked paste-token tiles so a brand can connect them from the panel instead of via the agent. Clarity is a single Data Export API token; PostHog uses a 3-step modal (Personal API Key + numeric Project ID + optional host, with numeric-id validation). Each token is vaulted brand-scoped and validated on the first insights pull; the load-bearing fix was adding the keys to CONFIG_FIELD_ALLOWLIST so the tile save cannot silently fail (the postscript-save-broken incident class). Locked by magic-tiles.test.js. TRIPLE WHALE shopDomain: the binary now handles the no-Shopify-connected case standalone. triplewhale-verify-key applies and PERSISTS an explicit shopDomain override so a brand with no Shopify stays scoped on future scheduled pulls, and a 403 is reported with shop-aware guidance that no longer echoes Triple Whale's response body into the user-facing error (Rule 6). The MCP triplewhale tool accepts shopDomain (forwarded to the binary). Locked by triplewhale_shopdomain_test.go (5) + mcp tool tests. APP RELIABILITY / SPEED / UX (RSI pass, 4-agent audit): fixed the reported brand-switcher bug where clicking a brand also opened the Revenue (stats) window behind the takeover. Root cause: the brand-switcher button is a child of the perf bar, whose click handler opens Revenue, and the button did not stop propagation. Centralized overlay sibling-hiding into one closeOtherOverlays() helper so opening one surface can never leave another stacked behind it (brand switcher / Wisdom / Palantir / Agency / Revenue), replacing five drifted hand-maintained lists. Guarded 6 missed async paths against stuck spinners, unhandled rejections, and brand-switch races (live-ads load, spellbook race, double-send, plus three IPC handlers that could reject the renderer on a malformed brand or a relay outage). Added a 1.5s, brands-dir-mtime-keyed memo to get-brands (called from ~14 sites on every brand switch, previously a synchronous N-file read + MD5 each time). Routed 5 raw backend error strings through friendlyError, and gave the universal modal proper dialog / aria-modal semantics. 14 new source-scan regression guards; full app JS suite green (1283 pass / 0 fail). NO BREAKING CHANGES. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.28.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.28.0: Palantir reimagined as a brand-tailored winning-ad-ideas wall + a redesigned 1-click brand switcher. Anchor: 2026-06-20. PALANTIR: the Palantir tab is no longer just a competitor-ad spy — it now AUTO-LOADS a full-window, sci-fi 'portal' wall of the top-performing ads in your brand's niche with ZERO typing, sourced from TrendTrack's ad-discovery API (POST /v1/ads/query, ranked by reach/spend — Meta-sourced — and tailored to your brand-manifest Category). Each ad is distilled into an actionable idea card (hook, format, why-it's-winning, advertiser) with a one-click 'Generate for my brand' that hands the winning angle to the creative engine for a fresh ON-BRAND riff (explicitly never a copy). New Go: trendtrackDiscoverAds (trendtrack.go, verified /v1/ads/query schema) + palantir_ideas.go aggregator/distiller + the palantir-ideas action + a main.js IPC; read-only by construction, every call routes through PreflightCheck + Record (api.trendtrack.io is in the hook blocklist), credit-frugal (1 credit/row, capped at 30), friendly errors (Rule 6). Graceful connect-CTA when no ad-intel platform is connected (never a dead wall). The Palantir toolbar button moved one slot RIGHT of Reports; tooltip is now exactly 'Palantir'; the named-competitor Foreplay spy is preserved as a secondary collapsed section. BRAND SWITCHER: the brand dropdown is replaced by a button that opens a FULL-WINDOW tile takeover — every brand a tile, plus a '+ New Brand' tile. Selecting a tile swaps brand in ONE click, instantly (the overlay closes immediately + the proven optimistic-preseed swap fires). '+ New Brand' opens a minimal Name + Website form whose Add activates the brand IMMEDIATELY and runs all ingestion (scrape, brand guide, products, competitors) in the background — zero friction, zero wait, zero mid-flow questions (honors the Brand Onboarding Zero-Friction rule). The hidden <select id=brand-select> is kept as the value-source so every existing brand-aware path (~25 call sites) + the proven swap logic stay untouched (no regression). Tests: palantir_ideas_test.go + 13 new renderer guards (Palantir auto-load / generate-bridge / full-takeover / button-position / tooltip / connect-CTA + brand-switcher button-not-dropdown / 1-click tile swap / new-brand instant+async / label-sync). Independently re-verified 10/10 on BOTH features with no Critical/High issues; full Go suite green (248s); full app JS suite green; build/vet/gofmt clean. NO BREAKING CHANGES — Palantir's competitor spy still works; the brand-swap logic is reused, not rewritten. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.27.0. ALSO IN v1.28.0: META AD-SET INSIGHTS: meta.go insights now pull campaign + ad-set + ad granularity in a single call, so reporting and optimization can act on ad-set-level performance (audiences, placements), surfaced to the agent through the meta insights path (tests in meta_test.go). RELIABILITY FIX (brand-scoped vault): fixed the Go binary's two-pass vault resolution. loadConfig's first '_global' pass collapsed every brand-scoped @@VAULT placeholder to '' before applyBrandVault could resolve it, so brand tokens (metaAccessToken, triplewhaleApiKey, etc.) stayed empty when the binary ran standalone. applyBrandVault now re-derives the original placeholders from an immutable pre-strip config snapshot and resolves them per-brand, with the cross-brand-leak guard intact. Production was never affected (the Electron app pre-resolves placeholders in Node before invoking the binary); this makes the binary correct on its own, defense in depth (vault_brand_pass_test.go). PRIOR RELEASE v1.27.0: OpenAI / ChatGPT Ads connector — Merlin can now run and manage paid ads inside ChatGPT. Anchor: 2026-06-19. NEW PAID-ADS PLATFORM: OpenAI Ads (api.ads.openai.com, US self-serve beta). Brand-specific BYOK: each brand mints an Ads API key at ads.openai.com and pastes it into a masked Connections tile (never in chat — it authorizes real spend). Full ad hierarchy: account → campaign → ad group → upload → ad → insights, all via openai_ads.go (Bearer auth; every call routes through PreflightCheck + RecordSuccess on a dedicated openai_ads rate-limit bucket). mcp__merlin__openai_ads actions: account/campaigns/insights (read), push (LAUNCH a live ad: builds the campaign + ad group, uploads the creative, creates the ad), pause. SPEND SAFETY (this connector spends real money, so it wires into every money rail like Meta/TikTok/Google): the push path is gated by FIVE layers — requireApproval (the Electron approval card sets cmd.Approved; the binary refuses to spend without it), validateDailyBudget on the FINAL micros→dollars value (daily cap + the $5000 cents-as-dollars hard ceiling), enforceMonthlyCap (straight-line monthly projection + the master pause-all flag), enforceAggregateMonthlyCap (cross-platform: sums active daily spend across every OTHER connected platform so OpenAI can't stack past the brand's MaxMonthlyAdSpend — like every other push path, CI-guarded), and recordActiveSpend after the create so the aggregate spend-anomaly guard sees the commitment. A mid-chain failure best-effort pauses the half-built campaign so it can never serve. OpenAI budgets are LIFETIME in micros (1,000,000 = $1); the campaign lifetime = dailyBudget × 30 and is validated against both maxDailyAdBudget (implied daily) and maxMonthlyAdSpend. The 'push' action also routes through the host SPEND_ACTIONS approval card with the cents-detector + budget context (Rule 19). api.ads.openai.com is in the hook blocklist so nothing bypasses the preflight or the spend rails. Errors are friendly (Rule 6) — no raw Go/HTTP/body/stack leaks. Brand-scoped vault (openaiAdsApiKey, openaiAdsAccountId) with disconnect coverage. Tests: openai_ads_test.go pins the 4-call create chain, the lifetime-budget micros math, Bearer auth, friendly errors with no body leak, the five-safety-layer source-scan (incl. the cross-platform aggregate cap + the orphan-campaign pause), the insights aggregation, the rate-limit + brand-scope registration; JS parity + persist + approval suites green. Hardened to 10/10 by a four-lens adversarial RSI pass (spend-safety, credential-security, reliability, UX). Full Go suite green; build/vet/gofmt clean. NO BREAKING CHANGES — opt-in, additive; no OAuth/worker changes (API-key auth). REGISTRATION: needs an OpenAI Ads API key from ads.openai.com (US beta, no minimum spend); works the moment it is pasted. MAGIC-PANEL TILES: added Triple Whale + OpenAI Ads tiles to the Brand Specific section (masked API-key paste, connection dot, disconnect), and fixed a tile-visibility bug where universal-scope tiles (Foreplay competitor-ad spying + TrendTrack ecommerce intelligence) silently disappeared on every recognized vertical and only showed when the brand's vertical was unknown. Root cause: the vertical filter hid every tile not in the active vertical's integrations list, including universal tiles that only survived by being duplicated into the creative-tools spread; Foreplay/TrendTrack were never in that spread. The filter now never hides data-scope=universal tiles, and the same-class gap that hid Mailchimp on every recognized vertical is fixed too (added alongside Klaviyo). Locked by app/magic-tiles.test.js (7 tests). NEW CONNECTOR: Rokt network reporting (api.rokt.com), READ-ONLY. Rokt's ad network has a real API but campaign management is dashboard-only (no write API), so this connector reports on Rokt campaign performance (impressions, referrals, spend via the Query API) and cannot launch or manage Rokt ads — that distinction is enforced by construction (rokt.go ships no write verbs; TestRoktSourceHasNoWriteVerbs). BYOK + brand-scoped: the brand provisions its OWN App ID + App Secret + Account ID at my.rokt.com (these are the brand's credentials, not Merlin's OAuth client, so Rule 2 doesn't apply — vaulted brand-scoped like any API key); rokt.go exchanges them for a 1h Bearer token (OAuth2 client_credentials, Basic auth) and reads the Query API, every call through PreflightCheck + RecordSuccess on a dedicated rokt rate-limit bucket. Connect is a 3-field tile modal (App ID / App Secret / Account ID); mcp__merlin__rokt actions report/status/connect/verify (read-only, no approval card). api.rokt.com is in the hook blocklist. Friendly errors (Rule 6), number-or-string metric coercion. Tests: rokt_test.go (Basic-auth token exchange, Bearer query, 2-row aggregation with string-metric coercion, friendly-no-leak, read-only source-scan, rate-limit + brand-scope). Requires an active Rokt advertiser account (enterprise-onboarded). Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.26.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.26.0: Triple Whale analytics connector + connector-hardening RSI pass. Anchor: 2026-06-19. NEW CONNECTOR: Triple Whale (brand-specific) end-to-end. Pulls the topline a CMO steers on that platform ROAS alone cannot show: New-Customer ROAS (newCustomersRoas), New-Customer CPA (newCustomersCpa), MER, blended + attributed ROAS, Net Margin, Ad Spend, Blended Sales, Net Profit, new-customer revenue/orders, plus Triple Whale's peer benchmarks. The Summary Page pull (POST api.triplewhale.com/api/v2/summary-page/get-data) routes through PreflightCheck + RecordSuccess (Rule 4) with a dedicated triplewhale rate-limit bucket; metric values are coerced number-or-string so a single string-typed metric can never poison the whole pull (US-grouped thousands parse, ambiguous EU decimals are skipped rather than misread). Two brand-specific credential paths, both Authorization: Bearer: OAuth2 (full Rule 17 wiring — Config OAuthTripleWhale, getTripleWhaleOAuth factory, bootstrapProviderKeys, oauth_exchange dispatch, autorefresh, brandScopedKeys, worker getOAuthCreds/getOAuthClientIDs) and a personal API key (app.triplewhale.com/api-keys) that works the moment it is pasted. api.triplewhale.com is in the hook blocklist so nothing bypasses the preflight. New MCP tool mcp__merlin__triplewhale (summary/status/connect/verify) + platform_login entry + connection-status + disconnect, all brand-scoped, tokens redacted and vault-only (never plaintext, never surfaced to the renderer). OAuth go-live needs the TRIPLEWHALE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET Cloudflare secrets + a registered TW app; the personal-API-key path is usable immediately. SHOPIFY LEGACY-TOKEN MIGRATION HARDENING (irreversible-op reliability): the /api/oauth/shopify-migrate endpoint is now recovery-first and idempotent. On a successful exchange the new token is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM, AAD=shop) keyed by the authenticated machineId for 24h (new migrate_recovery D1 table, cron-pruned), so a retry after a lost response returns the stored token instead of re-exchanging a now-revoked one (closes the crash-before-persist brick). Per-license rate limit on top of per-IP; the cron persist retries the shop_installs UPDATE; the D1 sync requires MERLIN_DASH_KEY so a keyless-but-DB-present deploy cannot burn the exchange. WORKER HARDENING: getOrdersLast30Days now paginates via the Shopify Link header (bounded, partial-on-error) so a store with more than 250 orders in 30 days stops under-reporting revenue; the compliance webhook logs a warning when a delete-topic arrives with no resolvable shop; getDecryptedToken was unexported (it bypassed the refresh choke-point). TRIPLE WHALE ERROR UX: every error path is friendly (Rule 6) — no raw Go transport strings, HTTP response bodies, JSON, or stack traces reach the user; raw detail goes to stderr only. UI FIXES: batch-image thumbnails now render reliably (eager load + bounded backoff + a teardown guard that stops retries on a detached card); the right-click context menu is no longer hidden behind the full-screen lightbox. RSI: independently re-scored to 10/10 across credential security, irreversible-op integrity, parser robustness, error UX, and test + performance, each fix locked by a regression test. Full Go suite green (247s); all landing + app JS suites green; build, vet, and gofmt clean. NO BREAKING CHANGES — Triple Whale is opt-in and additive; all hardening is backward-compatible. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.25.1. PRIOR RELEASE v1.25.1: Bug-fix release, three Meta binary fixes. Anchor: 2026-06-14. (1) FULL-RESOLUTION AD CREATIVES (#205): fetchMetaAdCreativeURLs now fetches ad-creative thumbnails at 1080px by sizing thumbnail_url on the AdCreative node directly. image_url is empty for post-based creatives (video and most statics), Meta ignores thumbnail_width/height on a nested creative{thumbnail_url} expansion, and an ad-account token cannot read the post's full_picture (needs pages_read_engagement, returns (#10)); the creative-node-direct fetch is the only path that returns presentation resolution. Fixes 64x64 thumbnails in the Archive grid and the weekly creative-showcase reports. Tests: TestMetaCreativeFetchPath + TestMetaCreativeSizedThumbPath. (2) CASE-INSENSITIVE BRAND LOOKUP (#204): brand resolution no longer returns an empty $0 'no platforms connected' dashboard when the requested brand name casing differs from the stored slug (for example APOTHEKE vs apotheke). (3) HONEST DISCOVER BINDING (#206): runMetaDiscover (the discover action, twin of the already-hardened runMetaLogin) now reports whether each ad account, page, and pixel was a real brandMatches hit, only claims 'matched brand X' when true, WARNs loudly on a fallback, and exposes adAccountMatched/pageMatched/pixelMatched in its JSON. Previously it silently bound the first active account and first page, and even printed '(matched brand X)' for a pure fallback; a brand was bound to an unrelated account and page and a full weekly report was generated on the wrong brand's data before a human noticed. Auto-pick is preserved (no mid-setup prompt), so zero-friction onboarding is unchanged. Tests: TestMetaPickByBrand + TestDiscover_HonestFallback. Full Go suite green (245s). NO BREAKING CHANGES: all three are bug fixes, binary-only (no app files or skills changed), so existing installs receive them through the normal binary auto-update. Signing remains in bootstrap mode (both pubkey constants empty), identical trust level to v1.25.0. PRIOR RELEASE v1.23.2: Critical fix — non-fal-namespace edit models (openai/gpt-image-2/edit, black-forest-labs/.../edit, etc.) were silently downgraded to their text-to-image variants. Live incident anchor: 2026-05-15. ROOT CAUSE: isFalEditModel (the upstream decision point that routes edit-vs-text-to-image) only detected the /edit segment on slugs starting with 'fal-ai/'. Any other namespace fell through to the legacy bare-alias `-edit` suffix check, which returns false for path-suffixed `/edit` slugs (the slug ends with `/edit`, not `-edit`). Result: isEditModel=false → router sent the call to falGenerateImage (text-to-image) → which called resolveFalImageSlug(slug, editMode=false) → which CORRECTLY strips `/edit` for text-to-image safety → silent downgrade. The agent passed `imageModel: 'openai/gpt-image-2/edit'`, the binary used `openai/gpt-image-2` (blind text-to-image) and pasted the reference flat-lay on top via composite. Model never saw the reference → wrong-looking creatives despite 'PIXEL-PERFECT' lock language in the prompt. This was the parallel fix that got missed on 2026-04-29 when resolveFalImageSlug + stripFalEditSuffix were updated for namespace passthrough — those two helpers became namespace-agnostic, but isFalEditModel stayed fal-ai/-only. CONTRACT VIOLATION: caller-supplied model strings are the caller's intent. The binary NEVER silently rewrites or downgrades. FIX: isFalEditModel now detects `/edit` segment on any slash-containing slug (fal-ai/, openai/, black-forest-labs/, anthropic/, google/, any future vendor). Mirrors what stripFalEditSuffix already did correctly. New model namespaces work automatically with zero code changes — the prerequisite for modular multi-vendor model support. Test coverage: fal_edit_detector_namespace_test.go pins behavior across 5 vendor namespaces (15 edit-detection cases + 16 non-edit cases + round-trip with stripFalEditSuffix + resolveFalImageSlug editMode=true passthrough + a source-scan regression guard that fails CI if anyone reintroduces the `hasFalPrefix(m)` fast-path that caused the incident).
